## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 323 captures during December 2019. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and indicates the volume submitted for review. The service should continue to monitor activity through routine operational reporting so that changes in capture levels can be identified and followed up. Any recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support timely investigation and resolution.

## Image quality

Of the 323 captures, 13 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.0. These captures could not be used for grading, and the result should be considered alongside the overall activity level. Continued attention to image capture and equipment performance is appropriate, with recurring camera issues recorded through the service desk.

## Grading

Grading identified 65 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 2. This records the central turnaround measure for the month and should be reviewed through normal service monitoring. The findings provide a summary of activity, image quality, and grading performance at Market Eye Clinic during December 2019.
